import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
-- Append to the raw warm mathlib-only imports; no Roth imports.
#check_failure Roth.wronskian_update_sub_smul
#check @Matrix.det_updateCol_add_smul_self
#check @Polynomial.hasseDeriv
open Polynomial
 theorem roth48_ring {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {l : ℕ}
    {φ : Fin l → R[X]} {ν ν' : Fin l} (h : ν ≠ ν') (c : R) :
    (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ
      ((Function.update φ ν' (φ ν' - C c * φ ν)) ρ)).det =
    (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ (φ ρ)).det := by
  refine (congrArg Matrix.det ?_).trans
    (Matrix.det_updateCol_add_smul_self
      (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ (φ ρ)) h.symm (-C c))
  ext μ ρ
  simp [Matrix.updateCol_apply, Function.update_apply, apply_ite,
    ← smul_eq_C_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
#print axioms roth48_ring
-- Pure existing-call bridge candidate, with no new helper in the proof.
 theorem roth48_compose {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {l : ℕ}
    {φ : Fin l → R[X]} {ν ν' : Fin l} (h : ν ≠ ν') (c : R) :
    (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ
      ((Function.update φ ν' (φ ν' - C c * φ ν)) ρ)).det =
    (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ (φ ρ)).det := by
  simpa [Matrix.updateCol_apply, Function.update_apply, apply_ite,
    ← smul_eq_C_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    (Matrix.det_updateCol_add_smul_self
      (Matrix.of fun μ ρ : Fin l ↦ hasseDeriv μ (φ ρ)) h.symm (-C c))
#print axioms roth48_compose
